name: print-social-flyer-purple-geometric-circles-proposal
title: Purple flyer with interlocking Bauhaus circles
whatItIs: An A5 flyer for a design proposal service, with a band of overlapping colored circles cut by thin black bars sitting between bold black headline text.
whatItMeans: The playful geometric motif signals 'creative but structured,' letting the flyer promise design expertise through its own layout rather than through imagery.
techniques: use a row of overlapping flat circles as a decorative divider instead of a photo
cut shapes with thin black strokes to add a hand-drawn, collaged feel
keep typography in pure black/white so the color budget goes entirely to the graphic band

vocabulary.definition: an early-20th-century design movement favoring primary shapes, colors and geometric abstraction
